com.vector.cfg.dom.runtimesys.groovy.api

Interface IUnmappedComElementAndSignalResult


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IUnmappedComElementAndSignalResult
    IUnmappedComElementAndSignalResult represents an ICommunicationElement and an IAbstractSignalInstance which were previously mapped to each other by an IDataMapping and are unmapped now.
    In case of a SenderReceiverToSignalGroupMapping, it contains also the information about the child mappings.
    Contains also the variance information of the removed IDataMapping.

    • Method Detail

      • getChildCommunicationElements

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.List<ICommunicationElement> getChildCommunicationElements()

        getChildCommunicationElements() is a getter for the child communication elements of getCommunicationElement() which were unmapped from group signal instances of getSignalInstance().

        The order of the communication element is relevant and matches the order of getGroupSignalInstances(). So the first child communication element was mapped to the first group signal, the second to the second group signal and so on.

        Returns:
        The child ICommunicationElements which were previously mapped by a complex IDataMapping to the getGroupSignalInstances(). In case the data mapping was not a SenderReceiverToSignalGroupMapping an empty list is returned.

      • getCommunicationElement

        @PublishedMethod
ICommunicationElement getCommunicationElement()

        getCommunicationElement() is a getter for the communication element which was unmapped from an IAbstractSignalInstance (can be accessed via getSignalInstance()).

        In case of a SenderReceiverToSignalGroupMapping the previously mapped children can be retrieved via getChildCommunicationElements().
        In case of a ClientServerToSignalMapping this getter returns the previously mapped call communication element.

        Returns:
        The ICommunicationElement which was previously mapped by an IDataMapping to the getSignalInstance().

      • getGroupSignalInstances

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.List<IAbstractSignalInstance> getGroupSignalInstances()

        getGroupSignalInstances() is a getter for the group signal instances of getSignalInstance() which were unmapped from child communication elements of getCommunicationElement().

        The order of the group signal instances is relevant and matches the order of getChildCommunicationElements(). So the first child communication element was mapped to the first group signal, the second to the second group signal and so on.

        Returns:
        The group signal instances which were previously mapped by a complex IDataMapping to the getChildCommunicationElements(). In case the data mapping was not a SenderReceiverToSignalGroupMapping an empty list is returned.

      • getPostBuildViewsOfMapping

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.List<IPostBuildView> getPostBuildViewsOfMapping()

        getPostBuildViewsOfMapping() is a getter for the variance information of the removed IDataMapping. It collects and return all IPostBuildViews for which the IDataMapping was visible.

        Returns:
        The IPostBuildViews for which the removed IDataMapping was visible. Returns a list containing the IInvariantView only, if the project contains no variants.

      • getReturnSignalCommunicationElement

        @PublishedMethod
 @Nullable
IOperationCommunicationElement getReturnSignalCommunicationElement()

        getReturnSignalCommunicationElement() is the corresponding getter to getCommunicationElement() for the previously mapped return signal communication element.

        Returns:
        The ICommunicationElement which was previously mapped by an IClientServerDataMapping to the getReturnSignalInstance(). Returns null if the removed data mapping was not an IClientServerDataMapping.

      • getReturnSignalInstance

        @PublishedMethod
 @Nullable
IAbstractSignalInstance getReturnSignalInstance()

        getReturnSignalInstance() is the corresponding getter to getSignalInstance() for the previously mapped return signal instance.

        Returns:
        The IAbstractSignalInstance which was previously mapped by an IClientServerDataMapping to the #getReturnCommunicationElement() in the role of the mapped return signal. Returns null if the removed data mapping was not an IClientServerDataMapping.

      • getSignalInstance

        @PublishedMethod
IAbstractSignalInstance getSignalInstance()

        getSignalInstance() is a getter for the IAbstractSignalInstance which was unmapped from an ICommunicationElement (can be accessed via getCommunicationElement()).
        In case of a SenderReceiverToSignalGroupMapping the previously mapped group signals can be retrieved via getGroupSignalInstances().

        Returns:
        The IAbstractSignalInstance which was previously mapped by an IDataMapping to the getCommunicationElement().
